machine_hours_reading_check.name: machine_hours_reading_check
machine_hours_reading_check.value: "farm"."machine_hours"."engine_hours" is not null or "farm"."machine_hours"."odometer_mi" is not null

machine_hours_values_check.name: machine_hours_values_check
machine_hours_values_check.value: ("farm"."machine_hours"."engine_hours" is null or "farm"."machine_hours"."engine_hours" >= 0) and ("farm"."machine_hours"."odometer_mi" is null or "farm"."machine_hours"."odometer_mi" >= 0)

operations_area_check.name: operations_area_check
operations_area_check.value: ("farm"."operations"."area_reported_ac" is null or "farm"."operations"."area_reported_ac" >= 0) and ("farm"."operations"."area_clipped_ac" is null or "farm"."operations"."area_clipped_ac" >= 0)

weather_forecasts_pct_check.name: weather_forecasts_pct_check
weather_forecasts_pct_check.value: ("farm"."weather_forecasts"."pop_pct" is null or "farm"."weather_forecasts"."pop_pct" between 0 and 100) and ("farm"."weather_forecasts"."sky_pct" is null or "farm"."weather_forecasts"."sky_pct" between 0 and 100) and ("farm"."weather_forecasts"."rh_pct" is null or "farm"."weather_forecasts"."rh_pct" between 0 and 100)
